title.zh-CN: 导数、函数变化与优化互动实验室

text.zh-CN: 通过割线逼近切线解释平均变化率如何趋近瞬时变化率。
text.en: Explain how secant slopes approach an instantaneous rate and tangent slope.

text.zh-CN: 联动函数图像、导函数和符号表，判断单调区间与临界点。
text.en: Link a function, its derivative, and a sign chart to determine monotonic intervals and critical points.

text.zh-CN: 把实际约束转化为单变量模型，并用导数和边界比较证明最优解。
text.en: Turn a constrained situation into a one-variable model and justify an optimum with derivatives and boundary checks.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 函数的图像、定义域与平均变化率。
prerequisites.en: Function graphs, domains, and average rates of change.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 基本代数运算与一次、二次函数。
prerequisites.en: Basic algebra and linear and quadratic functions.

text.zh-CN: 把导数值误认为函数在该点的纵坐标。
text.en: Confusing the derivative value with the function's height at that point.

text.zh-CN: 认为 f'(x)>0 等同于 f(x)>0。
认为任意 f'(x)=0 的点都是全局最大值。
text.en: Treating every point where f'(x)=0 as a global maximum.

invariants.zh-CN: 相同函数与探针位置必须产生可复现的函数值、导数值和符号表。
invariants.en: The same function and probe position must reproduce the same function value, derivative value, and sign chart.

invariants.zh-CN: 最优解必须同时检查定义域内部临界点和可行域边界。
invariants.en: An optimum must compare interior critical points with feasible-domain boundaries.

prompt.zh-CN: 缩小 Δx 前，预测割线斜率将趋近哪个值并说明依据。
prompt.en: Before reducing Δx, predict the value approached by the secant slope and explain why.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 预测与模拟极限一致，并明确区分函数值与斜率。
successEvidence.en: The prediction matches the simulated limit and distinguishes function value from slope.

prompt.zh-CN: 将导数符号区间与函数增减区间配对。
prompt.en: Match derivative-sign intervals to increasing and decreasing intervals.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 所有区间和临界点配对正确。
successEvidence.en: All intervals and critical points are matched correctly.

prompt.zh-CN: 选择最优参数，并用导数、可行域和边界值给出证明。
prompt.en: Choose the optimal parameter and justify it using the derivative, feasible domain, and boundary values.

successEvidence.zh-CN: 答案包含模型、临界点、边界比较和带单位结论。
successEvidence.en: The response includes the model, critical point, boundary comparison, and a conclusion with units.

steps: 仅用键盘改变 Δx 并播放割线趋近动画。
联动查看 f 与 f' 并完成符号表检查点。
完成一次约束优化并导出学习证据。
在两个外部测试站点中完成相同流程。
Change Δx and play the secant-limit animation using only the keyboard.
Inspect linked f and f' graphs and complete the sign-chart checkpoint.
Complete one constrained optimization and export learning evidence.
Repeat the flow in two external test hosts.

accessibility.zh-CN: 颜色之外还使用线型、标签和文字表达正负与增减。
accessibility.en: Line styles, labels, and text communicate signs and trends without relying on color.

accessibility.zh-CN: 动画可暂停、逐步执行，并在减少动态效果时保留状态变化。
accessibility.en: Animation is pausable and stepwise, and reduced motion preserves state changes.
